program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separator_candidates = [row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row)) == 1]
    separator_candidates += [grid[0][c] for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    separator = Counter(separator_candidates).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(value == separator for value in grid[r])]
    col_separators = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == separator for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_separators + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_separators + [w]
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row if value != separator).most_common(1)[0][0]
    output = []
    for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        output_row = []
        for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            count = sum(
                grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != separator
                for r in range(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1])
                for c in range(col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1])
            )
            output_row.append(1 if count % 2 == 0 else background)
        output.append(output_row)
    return output
'''
